answer: Watermarked task inputs trap collusion. The economy hands every key its own edition of each challenge - seeded synonym shifts invisible to the eye, like a vine grown through unique grain - so any text that reappears carries its origin. When a fleet shares one writer's work, the whisper of a borrowed watermark surfaces in another clone's answer and convicts both keys together. To stay safe, every clone must write fully independent material, erasing the scale economies that made the fleet worthwhile; a comet of copied answers leaves a trail pointing straight home.
